- Date of report: [MM/DD/YYYY]

- Allergies: [e.g., penicillin — rash]

[Your Full Name]

   - all replies and forwards as well?

- Convert any existing draft or reply now (if you tell me which email to convert).

- Allergien: [Falls vorhanden]

Bitte teilen Sie mir den frühestmöglichen Termin mit. Vielen Dank.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen  
[Ihr Vor- und Nachname]  
[Telefonnummer] | [E-Mail] | [Versicherung, optional]

Tell me your choices for 1–5 (or say “Use defaults”), and whether you want me to convert any current drafts or reply to a specific email in German now.
